rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Lesotho Prince
rows.Origin:
Bred by Pierre Orard (France, before 2009).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2009 as 'Lesotho Prince'.
rows.Bloom: Orange or orange-red. Orange vermilion, lighter reverse. None / no fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
